description:
Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0=extreme fear, 100=extreme greed) with optional history

Use when: You need to gauge overall crypto market sentiment or mood — whether the market is fearful or greedy.
Not for: you want token-specific sentiment — crypto_news (per-token headlines) or funding_rates (leveraged positioning).
Returns: value (0–100), value_classification (e.g. 'Greed'), optional history[]
Example response: {"value":10,"value_classification":"Extreme Fear","timestamp":1774137600,"source":"alternative.me"}

Price: $0.000 USDC per call

limit.description: Number of days of history to return (default 1, max 30)

name: fear_greed_index
